description: Empirical power matrix collapsed to a 1-D lookup of electrical power vs significant wave height Hs near resonance (Te~Tn). P = J(Hs,Te)*CWR_peak*diameter*eta_pto*eta_electrical, J=(rho*g^2/64pi)*Hs^2*Te. Capped at rated power.

cwr_peak.note: Peak capture width ratio at resonance

T_n_s.note: Natural resonance period of heaving buoy

Te_ref_s.note: Representative energy period for the lookup (near resonance)

P_rated_kw.note: Rated electrical power (curve clipped at rating)

power_kw.note: Electrical power near resonance, clipped at 80 kW rated

source: Falnes (2002); Babarit et al. (2012) Renew. Energy 41:44-63; CorPower Ocean datasheet; reuses EC135 F1a parameters
